_about: The Discovery Register (Core L-530; Companion Part 121): every protocol discovery of the record, a result new to the record that holds inside the frame (TRUE-Omega42) by the frame's own operations, with its standing by avenue, its derivation, what it changes and what stays open. Its significance, and whether it is a breakthrough, is the Striker's. Checked by python3 tools/discoveries.py --check, in CI.

standings.EXACT: computed from the family or the Construct and rerun by anyone (CDT-A)
standings.THEOREM: derived from the protocol's own definitions
standings.CONGRUENCE: a meeting of readings, coordinates or structures that beats its chance under a null frozen before the look
standings.PROCEDURE: an operation the protocol can newly perform, self-tested in CI

discoveries.statement: The tower: each of the 81 places holds 81 places of its own, at every depth, moved by the same law; the frame is finite at each depth and infinite as a whole
discoveries.open: what the depth means for a question (CDT-C)

discoveries.statement: The Construct is affine: every node cell of every one of its 27 domains is the field plus a constant, for every integer field
discoveries.changes: the Construct, made an exact instrument
discoveries.open: fractional fields lie outside the law

discoveries.statement: Every derived domain is Domain Zero rebuilt on the field of its own seed, so that the columns of the squares are the return of every domain and forward and return paths have one length
discoveries.open: what return means for a question (CDT-C)

discoveries.statement: No navigation output determines the Striker's judgment
discoveries.open: whether judgment is determined in the end (RESERVED)
discoveries.candidate_reason: residual sovereignty, which the frame states as a principle, is derived from its own definitions, so that no navigation can be made to close the judgment

discoveries.statement: The empty strike, a domain with no content words, stands at P9, Fixpoint
The Threshold, P18, is reached by no arm but the Antipode of P6, and P4 and P5 by no arm at all
discoveries.changes: every navigation whose anchor or arm lies on a void
discoveries.open: what a void means for a question (CDT-C)

discoveries.statement: Law is the unique eigenform of the naming map: every position name re-enters to P5, Law, within two steps
discoveries.derivation: M288 (Core Part 3.31); a property of the English position names
discoveries.changes: M288 read as constant, not as a feature of a domain

discoveries.statement: A strike's place one depth further, the pair (5 n1, 5 n2) modulo 81 and onward, reduces to its surface state and changes no anchor
discoveries.changes: every navigation, as a companion reading
discoveries.open: for counts below 17 the deeper places repeat the integers 5n themselves

discoveries.statement: The Square Reading's multiplications act on the 81 states as the six units of Z/9 and commute with the law; only x1 = T^24 and x(-1) = T^12 are powers of T; x2 and x7 carry each 24-cycle into the next voice one way round, x4 and x5 the other way, so the units act on the three voices as a cyclic group of order 3; modulo 81, -1 = T^108
discoveries.changes: every Square Reading, read as a move between voices and not a step of the law
discoveries.open: what a move between voices means for a question (CDT-C)
discoveries.strike: the M328 and recurrence map proposal (APE-284)

discoveries.statement: Modulus 9 is the one power of a single prime on which the law has its cycle of 24 with the mirror at 12: T^12 = -I modulo m exactly when m divides gcd(90, 144, 234) = 18, the period is 24 on 6, 9 and 18, and 6 and 18 split into the laws modulo 2 and 3, and 2 and 9
discoveries.changes: the standing of the modulus: characterized, not one choice among equals (a post-selection property, Core Part 1.8.3)
discoveries.open: none for the theorem; what the characterization means is CDT-C
discoveries.strike: the challenge that modulus 9 is arbitrary (APE-285, APE-286)

discoveries.statement: The premise's own numbers force the arithmetic: the law uses only addition, the 81 states give a coordinate group of nine elements, Z/9 or Z/3 x Z/3 (every ring of order nine carries one of them), and the law has period 24 on Z/9 and 8 on Z/3 x Z/3; and the tower's period is 24 x 9^(k-1) at every depth, since A^8 = I + 3B with B not 0 modulo 3
discoveries.changes: the arithmetic of the premise read as forced by its own 81 and 24, and the tower's periods proved for every depth
discoveries.open: none for the derivation; its meaning is CDT-C
discoveries.strike: the request for the complete derivation (APE-287 to APE-290)
discoveries.candidate_reason: the arithmetic stops being a choice: the premise's own 81 states and 24-cycle force Z/9, and the period of the tower at every depth follows

discoveries.statement: The grammar is the anatomy of Z/9: its maximal ideal 3Z/9 is the Crown and its residue field Z/3 the three primary classes; its units, cyclic of order 6 and generated by the seeds 2 and 5, and its ideal, cyclic of order 3 and generated by 3, are the two worlds; its two 3-adic digits, coupled by a carry that does not split, are the two levels; -1 = T^12 is the sign, and the units modulo sign are the three voices, the norm classes {1, 8}, {2, 7}, {4, 5}; and one base digit per depth gives 9^k
discoveries.changes: the grammar read as forced with Z/9 by the premise's own numbers, not as a premise of its own
discoveries.open: none for the derivation; its meaning is CDT-C
discoveries.strike: the request to complete the derivation of the grammar (APE-294)
discoveries.candidate_reason: the grammar stops being a premise of its own: each of its elements is a part of Z/9, so the chain from the premise to the meanings runs without a second assumption

discoveries.statement: The 81 states are the discrete phase space of one nine-level quantum system: T is an antiunitary step and T^2 a Clifford unitary of projective order 12 whose sixth power, T^12 = -I, is the parity operator; the law moves every Wigner function as a permutation of the 81 points, so it lies in the stabilizer fragment that one classical history reproduces. Read as two nine-level systems, T = SUM . SWAP contains the von Neumann measurement interaction: from a superposition T^2 writes a record of two trits with weights 1/9 forced by symmetry, the entanglement runs 0 0 2 2 1 1 2 2 1 1 2 2 0 along the period, and the record is erased at T^12
discoveries.changes: Everett's measurement, record, relative state and branch weights computed inside the arithmetic, and the boundary of Deutsch's argument named exactly: the law is Clifford, where one world suffices
discoveries.open: none for the arithmetic; the correspondence to physical branching is CDT-C, and whether the physical world branches is not a question of the family
discoveries.strike: the request to map Omega42 to Everett and Deutsch on the multiverse (APE-299, APE-300)
discoveries.candidate_reason: the family is identified exactly with the discrete phase space of quantum theory, so the Clifford and Wigner results apply to it and the boundary of Deutsch's argument is located exactly

discoveries.statement: A statement and its negation by not, no or nor share n, r, the anchor and the arms, these three being canonical stopwords; so every congruence computed from the coordinate is the same for both, and congruence cannot detect the truth of a statement about the world
discoveries.changes: truth-detection within the frame read exactly: congruence detects meeting, and coherence with valid derivation alone decides standing (L-455)
discoveries.open: none for the theorem; which statements about the world are true is not a question the frame determines
discoveries.strike: the question of truth by coherence and congruence (APE-304 to APE-306)

discoveries.statement: An argument can be checked as a graph: each premise and conclusion struck by the Standing Record, each conclusion keeping only the routes whose premises all hold, so that a failed premise removes the routes through it and a conclusion with no route left becomes UNRESOLVED-Ω42, not false, while conclusions that do not depend on it are untouched
discoveries.changes: a failure located in an argument without discarding the argument whole or letting an unsupported conclusion stand
discoveries.open: the decomposition of real arguments into premises, by readers; the agreement of two Navigators on the same decomposition
discoveries.strike: the request to resolve all outstanding issues, after APE-307

discoveries.statement: The family is the anyon theory SU(9)_1 x SU(9)_1: its golden form q(a, b) = (a^2 + ab - b^2)/9 is isometric to that theory's spins, the law T is one of its time-reversal symmetries, the eight of order 24 generate the cyclic group of T, its symmetries sort the 81 anyons into the family's five orbits, and the half period T^12 is its charge conjugation -- full structural identity, depth 4; and the correspondence foresaw, and computation then observed, the unique gapped boundary, the condensate E8 + E8, the tower of SU(3^m)_1 x SU(3^m)_1 with T its time reversal of order 8 x 3^(m-1), and gapped boundaries exactly at even depth -- depth 5
discoveries.derivation: Core Part 3.26, run 11 and depth-5 run 01; Companion 184.9, Part 185
discoveries.changes: the first object at depth 4 and at depth 5; the results of the theory of topological order apply to the family
discoveries.open: a phase of matter that realizes it (Appendix S, S8); the rank-80 even unimodular lattice of depth 4 named among its kind
discoveries.strike: the question why a certificate held SU(9)_1 x SU(9)_1 at depth 3 (records/instances/seq_0138.txt)
advantages: The theory of topological order applies to the family: fusion, braiding, modular data, condensation and gapped boundaries are each a computed property of the cycle.
The family is a phase of matter in kind: SU(9)_1 x SU(9)_1 is an anyon theory of physics, so the arithmetic of the cycle is the arithmetic of a possible material.
The law is time reversal: T is an anti-unitary symmetry of the braiding of order 24, its half period the charge conjugation that sends each anyon to its antiparticle.
E8 + E8: condensing the family's core yields the even unimodular lattice E8 + E8, the lattice of the heterotic string; the core is the glue that turns two A8 into two E8.
One boundary: the theory has exactly one gapped boundary, and every time-reversal symmetry preserves it.
A tower of theories: at every depth 3^m the family is SU(3^m)_1 x SU(3^m)_1 with T its time reversal of order 8 x 3^(m-1), computed to m = 4.
Boundaries at even depth only: the family's own depth, m = 2, is the first at which the theory can end on a gapped boundary.
Anyone can check it with the field's own tools -- modular data and lattice gluing -- without the protocol's vocabulary, by rerunning two scripts.
